name: Roller & Skyline® Shades
description: Roller and Skyline® Gliding Window Panels offer clean lines and modern styling, available in an extensive range of on-trend fabrics and colors.

benefits.text:
Benefits
Product Versatility
Almost every fabric in the collection is available as Roller Shades and Skyline® Panels providing a Whole 
House Solution™ for covering both vertical and horizontal window applications in the same room. 
Superior Functionality
PowerView® Automation provides the ultimate in home automation allowing you to control every 
shade with the touch of a button.
Roller Duolite® Shade
This unique and proprietary system combines a sheer or semi-sheer fabric with a room-darkening 
liner in a single shade. Allowing you to control the light and create privacy, beautifully.
Unmatched Fabrics
Sourced globally providing the most complete, comprehensive and extensive collection of woven 
fabrics on the market. Sumptuous textures and distinctive patterns in hues that cover the color 
spectrum define our collection.

mounting.text:
Panel Width
Panel Stack
11½" Panel	
Default Less Than 56" Wide	
17" Panel	
Default Greater Than 56" or Wider
Available exclusively in two panel widths, 11½" and 17". Panel widths are established based on size of your window. Panel width can be selected so that all panels 
in various windows are the same.
Left Stack	
Split Stack	
Right Stack
The minimal stack back provides maximum view-through. Stack back varies by shade size and panel width. With an outside mount, the panels can stack on the 
wall, providing an unobstructed view.
Light Orientation
Panel Overlap
Panel Orientation	
Bottom Light Direction
Control The Direction Light Enters The Room.
Skyline® Panels hang diagonally on the headrail creating a slim profile and allowing light to gently filter into a room. Because the panels hang diagonally on the headrail, 
there is a slight light gap where the fabric panels overlap one another. A 7⁄8" inch space at the top of each panel tapers and narrows, reducing the light gap to almost zero  
at the midway point to the bottom where the panels are connected. To ensure maximum privacy, select either a left or right facing panel orientation for your installation.
Minimum Panel Overlap	
Maximum Panel Overlap
Based on the size of the window, the panel overlap can vary. The overlap will be more visible on sheer fabrics. Panel overlap cannot be specified.
